caption: Figure 1: The (a) synchronous and (b) asynchronous execution ﬂow of traversing grid points in Multi-Grid PDE [65].
subject: how synchronous thread-switching hides remote-memory latency compared to asynchronous coroutine execution on one thread

groups.why_chosen: Same coloured step-blocks reused in both panels so the reader sees which steps (thread switching, context save) vanish moving from synchronous to asynchronous.
groups.what_to_learn: Colour-code each step type once (orange = context ops, blue = request/poll) and reuse those colours in both panels, then bracket the idle span the async version fills with useful work instead of a thread switch.
